import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.socbench.example"
session = requests.Session()

# Retrieve shipments currently in transit and their inventory tracking status.
shipments_response = session.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/shipments",
    params={"status": "in_transit"},
)
shipments_response.raise_for_status()
shipments = shipments_response.json()

# Retrieve all available products and their categories for cross-verification.
products_response = session.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/products",
    params={"availability": "available"},
)
products_response.raise_for_status()
products = products_response.json()

# Check restocking progress for the products being tracked.
product_ids = [product["id"] for product in products]
restocking_response = session.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/restocking",
    params={"product_ids": ",".join(map(str, product_ids))},
)
restocking_response.raise_for_status()
restocking = restocking_response.json()

# Submit suggested price changes only after comparing category inventory needs,
# shipment tracking, and restocking progress.
price_updates = []
for product in products:
    product_id = product["id"]
    category = product.get("category")
    shipment_records = [
        shipment for shipment in shipments
        if shipment.get("product_id") == product_id
    ]
    restock_records = [
        record for record in restocking
        if record.get("product_id") == product_id
    ]

    # Leave the suggested price unset unless the API data provides a validated
    # category-specific recommendation.
    suggested_price = product.get("suggested_price")
    if suggested_price is None:
        continue

    price_updates.append({
        "product_id": product_id,
        "category": category,
        "current_price": product.get("price"),
        "suggested_price": suggested_price,
        "inventory_need": product.get("inventory_need"),
        "shipment_status": [record.get("status") for record in shipment_records],
        "restocking_progress": restock_records,
    })

if price_updates:

        f"{BASE_URL}/price-updates",
        json={"updates": price_updates},
    )

import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.socbench.example"
session = requests.Session()

# Retrieve product categories currently in demand.
categories_response = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/product-categories/demand")
categories_response.raise_for_status()
categories_data = categories_response.json()

categories = categories_data.get("categories", categories_data if isinstance(categories_data, list) else [])
category_ids = [
    category.get("id")
    for category in categories
    if isinstance(category, dict) and category.get("id") is not None
]

# Retrieve detailed inventory levels across all store locations.
inventory_response = session.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/inventory",
    params={"category_ids": ",".join(map(str, category_ids)), "include_store_locations": "true"},
)
inventory_response.raise_for_status()
inventory_data = inventory_response.json()

# Identify retailers offering products in the demanded categories.
retailers_response = session.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/retailers",
    params={"category_ids": ",".join(map(str, category_ids)), "available": "true"},
)
retailers_response.raise_for_status()
retailers_data = retailers_response.json()
retailers = retailers_data.get("retailers", retailers_data if isinstance(retailers_data, list) else [])

# Fetch available retailers and their store locations.
retailer_ids = [
    retailer.get("id")
    for retailer in retailers
    if isinstance(retailer, dict) and retailer.get("id") is not None
]
locations_response = session.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/retailers/locations",
    params={"retailer_ids": ",".join(map(str, retailer_ids)), "available": "true"},
)
locations_response.raise_for_status()
locations_data = locations_response.json()

# Report gaps in availability or category representation based on the analysis.
feedback = {
    "categories": categories,
    "inventory": inventory_data,
    "retailers": retailers,
    "store_locations": locations_data,
    "gaps_or_discrepancies": [],
}

inventory_items = inventory_data.get("inventory", inventory_data if isinstance(inventory_data, list) else [])
for item in inventory_items:
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        continue
    quantity = item.get("quantity", item.get("available_quantity"))
    if quantity is not None and quantity <= 0:
        feedback["gaps_or_discrepancies"].append({
            "type": "unavailable_inventory",
            "category_id": item.get("category_id"),
            "product_id": item.get("product_id"),
            "retailer_id": item.get("retailer_id"),
            "store_location_id": item.get("store_location_id"),
            "quantity": quantity,
        })

represented_category_ids = {
    item.get("category_id")
    for item in inventory_items
    if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("category_id") is not None
}
for category in categories:
    if isinstance(category, dict) and category.get("id") not in represented_category_ids:
        feedback["gaps_or_discrepancies"].append({
            "type": "category_without_inventory_representation",
            "category_id": category.get("id"),
            "category_name": category.get("name"),
        })

feedback_response = session.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/feedback",
    json=feedback,
)
feedback_response.raise_for_status()
